title: 情感共情与态度表达
markdown:
# 情感共情与态度表达

## 概述

表达情感、共情和态度是人际沟通的核心。英语中有丰富的词汇和句型来传达喜怒哀乐、安慰关心和立场态度。本文整理高频情感词汇、共情安慰表达和态度立场句式。

## 正面情感 (Positive Emotions)

| 词汇         | 词性 | 含义       | 搭配                   | 强度 |
| ------------ | ---- | ---------- | ---------------------- | ---- |
| delighted    | adj. | 高兴的     | be delighted to/that   | ★★★  |
| thrilled     | adj. | 激动的     | be thrilled about/with | ★★★★ |
| grateful     | adj. | 感激的     | be grateful for/to     | ★★★  |
| relieved     | adj. | 如释重负的 | feel relieved that     | ★★★  |
| enthusiastic | adj. | 热情的     | be enthusiastic about  | ★★★★ |
| optimistic   | adj. | 乐观的     | be optimistic about    | ★★★  |
| proud        | adj. | 自豪的     | be proud of            | ★★★  |
| satisfied    | adj. | 满意的     | be satisfied with      | ★★   |
| confident    | adj. | 自信的     | feel confident about   | ★★★  |
| inspired     | adj. | 受到启发的 | be inspired by         | ★★★  |

### 听说例句

```
A: How did the presentation go?
B: It went great! The client was thrilled with our proposal.
A: That's fantastic! You must be proud of the team.
B: Absolutely. I'm really grateful for everyone's hard work.
A: I'm delighted to hear that. This makes me optimistic about Q4.
```

## 负面情感 (Negative Emotions)

| 词汇         | 词性 | 含义           | 搭配                      | 强度 |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------- | ------------------------- | ---- |
| frustrated   | adj. | 沮丧的         | feel frustrated with/by   | ★★★  |
| overwhelmed  | adj. | 不堪重负的     | feel overwhelmed by       | ★★★★ |
| anxious      | adj. | 焦虑的         | be anxious about          | ★★★  |
| disappointed | adj. | 失望的         | be disappointed in/with   | ★★★  |
| upset        | adj. | 不安的、难过的 | be upset about            | ★★   |
| exhausted    | adj. | 精疲力竭的     | feel completely exhausted | ★★★★ |
| irritated    | adj. | 恼怒的         | be irritated by           | ★★   |
| embarrassed  | adj. | 尴尬的         | feel embarrassed about    | ★★   |
| insecure     | adj. | 没有安全感的   | feel insecure about       | ★★   |
| resentful    | adj. | 愤恨的         | feel resentful toward     | ★★★  |

### 听说例句

```
A: You look a bit down today. What's wrong?
B: I'm frustrated with this project. Nothing seems to work.
A: I totally understand. It sounds like you're overwhelmed.
B: Yeah, and I'm anxious about the deadline.
A: Don't be too hard on yourself. Let's figure this out together.
```

## 共情与安慰 (Empathy & Comfort)

| 短语                           | 含义                 | 使用场景 |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------- | -------- |
| I know how you feel.           | 我理解你的感受。     | 表达共情 |
| That must be really tough.     | 那一定很难受。       | 表达理解 |
| I'm sorry to hear that.        | 听到这个我很遗憾。   | 坏消息   |
| Hang in there.                 | 坚持住。             | 鼓励     |
| It's going to be okay.         | 一切会好的。         | 安慰     |
| You're not alone in this.      | 你不是一个人在战斗。 | 支持     |
| Take your time.                | 不着急，慢慢来。     | 给予空间 |
| Is there anything I can do?    | 有什么我能帮的吗？   | 主动帮助 |
| I've been there.               | 我经历过。           | 表达共情 |
| Don't be too hard on yourself. | 别对自己太苛刻。     | 减轻自责 |

### 听说例句

```
A: I didn't get the job I applied for.
B: I'm sorry to hear that. That must be really disappointing.
A: Yeah, I put so much effort into the interview.
B: I've been there. It's tough, but hang in there.
A: Thanks. I'm trying not to take it personally.
B: Don't be too hard on yourself. The right opportunity will come.
   Is there anything I can do to help?
```

### 写作表达

- I completely **empathize** with the challenges you are facing.
- We understand this situation is **frustrating** and sincerely **apologize** for the inconvenience.
- Please know that we are here to **support** you through this transition.

## 态度与立场 (Attitude & Stance)

| 词汇        | 词性 | 含义       | 搭配                 |
| ----------- | ---- | ---------- | -------------------- |
| supportive  | adj. | 支持的     | be supportive of     |
| skeptical   | adj. | 怀疑的     | be skeptical about   |
| indifferent | adj. | 漠不关心的 | be indifferent to    |
| determined  | adj. | 坚定的     | be determined to do  |
| hesitant    | adj. | 犹豫的     | be hesitant about    |
| open-minded | adj. | 开放的     | be open-minded about |
| stubborn    | adj. | 固执的     | be stubborn about    |
| neutral     | adj. | 中立的     | remain neutral on    |
| passionate  | adj. | 热情的     | be passionate about  |
| committed   | adj. | 坚定投入的 | be committed to      |

### 表达态度的句型

| 句型                           | 含义            | 示例                                     |
| ------------------------------ | --------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| I'm all for it.                | 我完全支持。    | I'm all for remote work.                 |
| I have mixed feelings about... | 我对…感受复杂。 | I have mixed feelings about the merger.  |
| I'm strongly against...        | 我强烈反对…     | I'm strongly against cutting the budget. |
| I'm leaning toward...          | 我倾向于…       | I'm leaning toward option A.             |
| I reserve judgment on...       | 我对…保留看法。 | I reserve judgment until I see the data. |

### 听说例句

```
A: What do you think about the new policy?
B: I have mixed feelings about it. The intention is good,
   but I'm skeptical about the implementation.
A: I'm all for it, personally. I think it'll help the team.
B: I'm open-minded, but I'd like to see some data first.
A: Fair enough. Let's reserve judgment until the trial period is over.
```

## 鼓励与激励 (Encouragement & Motivation)

| 短语                             | 含义                   | 场景     |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -------- |
| You've got this!                 | 你能行！               | 鼓励     |
| Keep up the good work!           | 继续加油！             | 表扬     |
| I believe in you.                | 我相信你。             | 信任     |
| Don't give up.                   | 别放弃。               | 鼓励坚持 |
| You're on the right track.       | 你走在正确的路上。     | 肯定方向 |
| That's a great start!            | 开了个好头！           | 正面反馈 |
| Every little bit counts.         | 每一点努力都有意义。   | 鼓励积累 |
| Look how far you've come!        | 看你已经走了多远！     | 回顾进步 |
| The hard part is over.           | 最难的部分已经过去了。 | 减轻压力 |
| You should be proud of yourself. | 你应该为自己骄傲。     | 肯定     |

### 听说例句

```
A: I'm not sure my code is good enough for the review.
B: Don't sell yourself short. You've got this!
A: But there are so many edge cases to handle.
B: Look how far you've come — the core logic is solid.
   Every little bit counts. Keep up the good work!
A: Thanks. That really means a lot.
B: I believe in you. You should be proud of yourself.
```

## 道歉与谅解 (Apology & Forgiveness)

| 短语                        | 含义             | 语域   |
| --------------------------- | ---------------- | ------ |
| My bad.                     | 我的错。         | 非正式 |
| I owe you an apology.       | 我欠你一个道歉。 | 正式   |
| I didn't mean to...         | 我不是故意…      | 中性   |
| I take full responsibility. | 我承担全部责任。 | 正式   |
| No hard feelings.           | 不要介怀。       | 非正式 |
| Water under the bridge.     | 过去的事了。     | 非正式 |
| Apology accepted.           | 道歉接受。       | 中性   |
| Don't worry about it.       | 别放在心上。     | 非正式 |
| These things happen.        | 这种事常有。     | 安慰   |
| Let's move on.              | 我们往前看吧。   | 中性   |

### 听说例句

```
A: I'm sorry I missed your message yesterday. My bad.
B: Don't worry about it. These things happen.
A: I owe you an apology for the late response on that PR.
B: No hard feelings. I know you've been swamped.
A: Thanks for understanding. Let's move on to the next sprint.
```
